description: Opt in or out of semantic features using existing user authorization and scope. Global flags still apply. allow_private explicitly permits provider processing of your private memory, contact notes, request objectives and task context. Use current revision. Changes skip historical backfill. automatic permits workers to act only inside standing user scope.

authorization.description: Existing user's authorization, never inferred from peers

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

items.description: context, attention, commitments, contacts, memory, pages

scope.description: User's bounded scope for automatic actions

name: semantic_policy_update
